body:
Brand Design Process Step by Step

‍

Starting or refreshing your brand is a thrilling journey, but it can feel overwhelming with all the choices and creative details. 

What are the steps of brand design?

That's why we've compiled a simple guide to help you navigate this process smoothly. Join us as we explore the ins and outs of building your brand, from the beginning steps to the exciting moment of unveiling your unique brand story. 

Let's make this journey together!

‍

1. ONBOARDING PHASE—Let's Figure out Your Plan Together

2. CONTRACT AND DOWN PAYMENT—Making Things Official

3. RESEARCH PHASE—Setting the Mood for Creativity

4. CLIENT PRESENTATION—Sharing the Vision

5. DESIGN PHASE—Making Your Brand Look Awesome

6. REVISION ROUNDS—Making It Just Right

7. BRAND AND LOGO GUIDELINES—Your Brand's Easy Guide

8. PROJECT DELIVERY—Your Brand's Special Package

CONCLUSIONS—Your Brand's Story is Ready to Shine!

‍

ONBOARDING PHASE—Let's Figure Out Your Plan Together

We're starting this journey by having a friendly chat. We'll ask you some easy questions to determine your brand needs. Then, we'll put together a plan for making your brand stand out – a strategy we'll work on together. 

‍

Kick things off with a short call—it's like a friendly chat to get to know your project.

Ask questions from the brand strategy brief to understand what makes this journey unique. With insights from the call, it's time to map out the project scope. What needs to be done? What's the destination? 

Craft a proposal that's as clear as a starry night. Outline the project scope, timeline, and costs. Make it simple; make it exciting! 

Share your proposal with the client—it's like handing over the captain's hat. Walk them through the plan, answer any questions they might have, and get their thoughts.

Once the proposal is approved, go into your project with enthusiasm! With a strong proposal, a happy client, and a quick start, it's not just a project kickoff – it's the beginning of an exciting journey. May your project journey be smooth and successful! 

 

 Contract and Down Payment—Making Things Official

Once you're excited about the plan, we will make things official but in an amicable way. We'll give you a simple agreement, and you'll save some money. This shows we're both committed to making something extraordinary for your brand. 

‍

 

‍

Time to draft our project rules in a contract. Think of it as setting the stage for our project play. Include all the nitty-gritty details so everyone's on the same page. 

Present the contract to our client. Before we set sail, let's ask for a 50% down payment. This helps us commit and covers the initial project costs. Win-win! 

 Let's sign on the dotted line once everyone's clear and the down payment is in. It's official!

‍

RESEARCH PHASE—Setting the Mood for Creativity

Now, picture us sitting down and chatting more about your brand. We will create a mood board to set the tone for our creative adventure. Define the brand strategy brief together. What makes us unique? What's our story? These are the building blocks of our creative journey. Work on the brand strategy presentations, outlining our brands' who, what, and why. It's not just a plan; it's the soul of our project. 

 

‍

Time to add some style! Develop stylescapes that capture the visual vibe we want for our brand. It's like curating a visual mood board that sets the creative direction for our project. Let's make it appealing and uniquely us. Present the brand strategy and stylescapes to your team. It's not just a presentation; it's your chance to ignite excitement and passion for the creative journey ahead.

 After the presentation, open the floor for ideas. It's like a brainstorming extravaganza—collect thoughts, inspirations, and suggestions from the team. This collaboration fuels the creative fire and ensures everyone is on the same page. 

 Use the feedback to refine your brand strategy and stylescapes. Think of it as sculpting a masterpiece—smooth out the edges until you have a clear and captivating vision for your brand.

 

 

 

 

‍

CLIENT PRESENTATION—Sharing the Vision

It's showtime! We will show you our ideas in a way that's easy to understand. We want to make sure what we're thinking matches your thoughts. It's like sharing ideas with a friend.

 

‍

It's time to kick off the design phase! Start brainstorming and sketching to develop that stellar logo and visual identity. Once your design concepts are ready, present these creative gems in a project presentation. Explain the thinking behind each idea and listen to what your client likes or suggests. Pay attention to the details and gather feedback from your client. Any suggestions from them?

Use your artistic skills to choose colors, fonts, and graphics that work well together. Make sure the design looks good on different platforms. Keep talking to your clients to ensure you create a design they love!

It's time to add those final touches. This step ensures your logo and visual identity shine like beacons of awesomeness. Share the polished design concepts with your client, and watch as the magic unfolds. It's the moment where your creative vision becomes a tangible reality. 

 

 

 

‍

DESIGN PHASE—Making Your Brand Look Awesome

Here comes the fun part! We're going to make your brand look amazing. We will make your brand look amazing by creating a unique logo and style. We'll show you what we come up with and listen to your thoughts. 

 

‍

It's time to let those creative juices flow! Begin the design phase by brainstorming and sketching ideas for the logo and visual identity. Think of it like an artistic adventure—exploring different concepts to find the one that captures the essence of our brand.

Take your best design concepts and bring them to life. Let the visuals tell the story of our brand, whether it's on paper or the digital canvas. This is where our project gets its unique visual flair. 

Present your design concepts in a project presentation. Think of it as the grand premiere of your masterpiece. Walk your client through the thought process, inspirations, and details behind each concept. What resonates with them? What tweaks do they suggest? Use this feedback to refine and enhance your design concepts until they sparkle like diamonds.

Celebrate your hard work! You've successfully navigated the design phase, and your brand is now dressed to impress. It's a moment to appreciate the creative journey and the fantastic design you've crafted for your project. 

 

 

‍

REVISION ROUNDS—Making It Just Right

Let's work together to make everything perfect. We'll change things based on what you tell us until we get to a logo and look you love. Gather around for a virtual team huddle—it's time to collaborate!

 

‍

Engage with your client, listen to their thoughts, and understand their vision. This step is all about ensuring everyone is on the same creative wavelength. Share the initial design and gather feedback. What's working well? Any adjustments they'd like?

Based on the feedback, twirl into action! Make those tweaks, refine details, and add a dash of finesse. This is where the dance gets smoother, and your design shines even brighter. Engage in discussions, share updated designs, and ensure your client feels heard. 

Collaboration is the secret sauce for a design that wows. Share the revised design, gather feedback, and make those final tweaks. It's a back-and-forth, ensuring every detail aligns with your client's vision. 

 

 

‍

7. Brand and Logo Guidelines

Think of this as a simple guidebook for your brand. It's just one page and tells everyone how to use your brand. Easy. It's like having a map for our adventure. 

Establish comprehensive brand and Logo Guidelines that cover everything—colors, fonts, logo usage, you name it. It's like the secret recipe to keep your brand consistently excellent. 

‍

 

‍

Now, let's condense that magic into a brand stylesheet. Picture it as a quick reference guide—a cheat sheet that outlines the critical elements of your brand. Simple, sleek, and packed with the essentials. 

Highlight your brand's color palette is like a pro! Use the brand stylesheet to showcase your primary and secondary colors. It's like painting a vivid picture that screams, "This is us!" 

Choose fonts that speak your brand's language and feature them proudly on your brand stylesheet. Ensure your words look as good as they sound. 

 Show different versions, outline clear spacing rules, and ensure your logo looks top-notch. Use the brand stylesheet to guide everyone in your team. It's the compass that ensures everyone stays on the same branding course. 

 Share your Brand and Logo Guidelines with your team and anyone who might wave your brand flag. It's like giving them the keys to the brand kingdom—ensuring everyone represents your brand with pride. Creating Brand and Logo Guidelines is like establishing the rules for your brand party. With a brand stylesheet, you're not just setting rules but creating a visual guide that ensures your brand shines consistently.

‍

PROJECT DELIVERY—Your Brand's Special Package 

 As we wrap things up, it's like getting a particular package. Inside, you'll find everything we made for your brand – a fantastic logo and other useful stuff. And we'll make sure you know exactly how to use it. Ensure every detail is in place, every pixel is perfect, and our project looks its best.

‍

Time to unveil the star of the show! Our project is not just about the logo; it's the whole package! Bundle up all the design assets, from graphics to illustrations, making sure they're easily accessible for any future creative endeavors. Please think of this as the user manual for our project. Provide a clear and concise file format sheet that guides everyone on the types and sizes of files included.

Deliver the finalized project to your client, teammates, or whoever's eagerly waiting. Make it an event, whether a digital drop or a physical delivery. It's the grand finale of our creative masterpiece. 

 Celebrate the victory! You've successfully delivered a project that meets and exceeds expectations. It's a moment to revel in the team's hard work, creativity, and collective success. Delivering a project is like handing over a carefully wrapped gift. With a logo package, design assets, and a transparent file format sheet, you're not just delivering—you're gifting a visual legacy. 

 

 

 

‍

CONCLUSIONS—Your Brand's Story is Ready to Shine!

 You did it! Your brand now has its special look – like a friendly adventure we went on together. It's been a team effort, from chatting about your brand to creating a logo you love. Imagine your brand as a story we made with colors and shapes, and now it comes with a simple guide so everyone can tell that story the same way. As we hand over your brand's special package, it's not just about logos; it's like giving you a treasure chest full of tools to make your brand unforgettable. So, here's to your brand – a unique and friendly presence. Your story is set; we can't wait to see it make people smile. Thanks for letting us be part of your brand's adventure!
